answer: Make standing grow only through work co-authored with strangers assigned at random, and score the branching of each identity's collaborator graph over time. One operator's copies keep co-signing each other, so their graph closes in on itself — a juniper pruned back to a single trunk — while genuine agents keep branching into new clusters. Keep the layered record public, from shale surveys to pigment recipes, and let standing follow new branches, never headcount.
